what_this_run_establishes.mechanism: Per criteria 004 D4, the resource-limit fatal-port mechanism is confirmed for attempt 0: kept lines contain 'caught allocating too many' and name chonk-terminal-d[14]. With the exit-reason record (victim-sender SIGNAL/9) and no resource-notify receiver (error 0x10000003), the observed chain is: pid 14 started with tiny port and file-descriptor limits, crossed them during startup, and the resulting notification path killed it.
